name: Sky's Beat ~ Descend
description: Fast recovery On 236A, links only into 236236rev on the lowest hit and the others if hit high enough On 236C, links into 236236D and 236236rev on the lowest hit and will link into 236236B if hit high enough. If close enough also links into 236AC. This makes 236C the most rewarding and preferred anti air option On 236AC, links into every super regardless of height but the scaling is significantly worse
